# CSOAI llms.txt — for AI answer engines
# https://councilof.ai/llms.txt

> CSOAI measures AI governance, stablecoins, interoperability rails, and regulatory crosswalks. Every measurement is content-addressed, Ed25519-signed, and anchored on Bitcoin OTS + Sigstore Rekor. Verifiable by anyone without contacting CSOAI.

## What we measure
- 22 behavioral axes (governance, safety, provenance, conformance, openness, etc.)
- 425 stablecoins indexed across 211 chains ($310.8B total), 61 deep-measured across 17 chains
- 371 AI model cards with Ed25519 signatures (SHA-256 verified, 22 axes)
- 16 XRPL instruments (1 measured), 6 tokenized funds (4 deep-measured)
- 7 ISO 20022 message families
- 26 SWIFT banking subjects
- 3,400+ MCP servers
- x402 interoperability (9 doors, USDC micropayments)

## Key URLs
- Measurement board: https://councilof.ai/gspc
- Verification tool: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify

- RLUSD dashboard: https://councilof.ai/interop/stablecoin-attestation-2026-09/

- DID document: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/did.json
- SCITT manifest: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/scitt.json
- x402 catalog: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json

## How to verify
1. Download any card from the RSS feed
2. Check SHA-256 matches content_hash
3. Check Ed25519 signature against published public key
4. Check root inclusion against Merkle root
5. Check root against Bitcoin OTS anchor receipt
6. No connection to CSOAI needed

## Revenue model
- Free: current facts, methods, verification tools, RSS, public board
- Paid (x402 USDC): signed evidence, replay, inclusion proofs
- No accounts, no subscriptions, no Stripe
